purpose: Fresh Gate 3 blind benchmark tranche C for the merged r13 candidate. Questions are frozen before the first live run and must not be used to tune candidate behavior before that run.
blindnessPolicy: Do not edit this tranche after its first paid live run except to preserve an immutable record of what was run.
Any failed tranche-C case may become a regression after diagnosis, but it may not be reused as evidence of a later blind pass.
If candidate behavior changes after tranche C, certify the changed behavior with a newly authored blind tranche.
Tranche C must not exactly reuse questions from Gate 2 or Gate 3 tranches A or B.

cases.question: During setup my token is placed on my starting Territory. Does that placement count as movement or as entering the Territory for an enter trigger?
When setting up, do I choose my opening discard before or after learning who takes the first turn, and does that discard count as paying another card's discard cost?
expectedAnswerPatterns: without knowing who will take the first turn

cases.question: An effect gives me an additional Action this turn but does not name a special phase. May I take both Actions during Opening?
expectedAnswerPatterns: does not permit multiple Actions in one phase

cases.question: I have movement remaining when I enter the opponent's Position and start a battle. If the battle finishes, may I spend the unused movement from that same movement sequence?

During a battle, are cards in my Reserve considered cards in my Hand for an effect that specifically tells me to choose a card from Hand?
I just won the battle that forced my opponent beyond their end of the Gauntlet. Does that win itself immediately begin the Last Stand, or do I need another legal movement sequence?
I win an attack on an enemy-controlled Territory and remain there. Does that battle win itself give me control of the Territory?
When the General spends Command on an Order such as Onward or Rally, does using the Order consume the normal Action for the turn?
My opponent accepts an unratified Proposal I offered as Terms. What happens to the staked Influence, and what normal Influence reward comes from the new ratification?
Financial Capacity qualifies after Capture because my Treasury value is higher than my controlled Territories. If my Treasury value drops later that turn, do I lose the two-phase Action permission?
I already used Surveillance on the opponent's Gambit this battle. Can I still use Surveillance on their face-down Tactics later in the same battle?
After completing all three Rites, which three zones must supply the Arcane cards I bind to begin the Ritual of Ascension?
Four opposing cards enter the Graveyard during the Aftermath of one battle involving the Inquisition. How much normal Conviction does that Aftermath generate?
When may the General use Onward, what does it cost, and can its extra Position start a battle?
The Commandant wins as defender and uses Repel. Does the opponent take the extra retreat before or after their normal retreat, and how far is the extra retreat?
The opponent accepts the Ambassador's Terms. What card-flow benefit does Cordiality give, assuming it has not been used this turn?
The Senator is about to lose 2 staked Influence after refused Terms and puts exactly one card from Hand into the Graveyard with Political Capital. How much staked Influence is recovered?
On the Banker's first Deed purchase this turn, the purchase cost is 5. If Line of Credit uses collateral, what is the most that collateral can contribute and how much Capital must pay the rest?

The Executive won as attacker and is occupying an enemy Territory without controlling it. For Hostile Takeover's Deed purchase, how is the Executive treated for the purchase cost, and what happens to the Front Line if the purchase succeeds?
Fieldcraft ignores a qualifying printed Territory effect. How long does that ignored effect stay ignored?
expectedAnswerPatterns: until the end of the turn

cases.question: After the Spymaster completes a normal Mission, may Mission Control immediately start a Special Operation from Hand as the replacement?
Materia Prima is triggered by a qualifying sacrifice from Hand during a battle. When is the Alchemist's card draw actually made?

The Spirit Walker has completed one Rite when a battle loss would interrupt progress. What minimum-value Arcane card can Guardians of the Circle put from Hand into the Graveyard to prevent the interruption?
The Grand Inquisitor wins a battle. Does Final Judgment Purge happen before battle cards clear or after, and can the normal Conviction gain from that battle occur first?
The Witch Hunter wins a battle they initiated as the attacker. Does that win satisfy Relentless Pursuit's trigger?
Advance Guard's additional Movement starts a battle. What restriction does that create on my Gambit in that battle?
Armistice is banked at the start of my Opening. What must I do to keep it in play, and may I simply discard Armistice voluntarily at some unrelated time?
expectedAnswerPatterns: discard two cards from your Hand

cases.question: I use Assassins as a Gambit or Tactic, but the opponent set no Gambit. What does Assassins do in that case?
Assimilation applies after I win as attacker on an enemy-controlled Territory. If I advance my Front Line with Assimilation, do I also occupy that Territory?
I won a battle this turn and want to play Battlefield Promotion for its Action. When may I play it, and where must the Tactic I recover currently be?
Black Covenant is my Tactic. Where does its +1 Tactic come from, and where do Black Covenant and that extra card go in the Aftermath?
I choose Brothers in Arms as my Tactic after setting no Gambit and take its +1 Tactic from Hand. Where does that added Tactic go in the Aftermath?
Capital Gains is bound to a Treasury card, but I lose a battle before the next-turn income timing. What happens to Capital Gains and the bound Treasury card?
Confession reveals an opposing face-down Tactic before normal reveal. What may I do with Confession itself after that reveal?
expectedAnswerPatterns: return this card to your Reserve

cases.question: I use Contraband as a battle card to replace it with an eligible Gambit or Tactic from my Discard Pile. Where does Contraband go immediately, and where does the chosen replacement normally go in the Aftermath?
What if I lose a battle before that next income happens?

history.content: I played Capital Gains and bound it to a card in my Treasury. What happens next turn?
After income on your next turn, the bound Treasury card returns to your Hand, you gain Capital equal to its value, and Capital Gains is discarded.

cases.question: If that extra step is the one that starts the fight, can I still put down a Gambit?

history.content: I played Advance Guard during Opening. What does the movement part do?
During your Movement this turn, Advance Guard may move you one additional Position.

cases.question: Separate issue: a printed Territory effect is slowing my Ranger. How long does Fieldcraft shut that effect off?

history.content: When accepted Terms ratify a Proposal, do I get Influence?
A newly ratified Proposal normally gives the Diplomat 1 Influence.

expectedAnswerPatterns: until the end of the turn

cases.question: After I peek at theirs, can I pull this one back into Reserve and pick a different Tactic?

history.content: I chose Confession as my Tactic. What happens before Tactics normally reveal?
Confession can reveal one opposing face-down Tactic before normal reveal.
